result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it easier for people to understand one another deeply — not just words, but experiences, fears, hopes, and context.

A lot of the world’s worst problems are amplified by misunderstanding, dehumanization, or the inability to see beyond one’s own circumstances. If empathy and clear communication were more instinctive, many conflicts would shrink, cooperation would grow, and suffering would likely decrease in countless ways.
